title: StudioTranslationImportRequest
description: POST .../translations/import and POST .../translations/:lang/import-change (2.27.0). The returned ChatGPT files (translations-partNN.json, fix files, report.json), read by the browser as text.

confirmed.description: Must be true for the request to change anything. Without it the Worker changes nothing and answers 200 { changed:false, confirm:{title,message} }.
